best_idea: Pick each prop's detail level from its on-screen size proxy (bounding-box area times scale), let the quality tier scale the draw distance, and skip the top level when it would only show up very close.
decision_why: The area formula and the switch-floor skip are cheap and fit zones-as-data, but the donor keeps two sources of truth (authored distances are overwritten for track objects and items), so Frankendom takes one source per prop and pins duel actors to level 0 (STK pins the top LOD for its finish camera, kart_model.cpp:1082-1087).
acceptance: On the lowest quality tier a zone prop at its draw distance steps down one level and never shows its top mesh at close range, and the up to 3 engaged attackers stay on level 0 for the whole duel (a client test asserts the pin).
